title: Use English menu labels while preserving debug routes
changes: Use English source keys for sidebar presentation, five menu rows and control hints while retaining existing localized text and legacy debug route tokens.
validation: Offline Linux combined menu/screen build passed 25 targeted Atlas, route, control and localization tests, with one optional Atlas image export ignored. Both 593-entry language catalogs validate; tests compare English/Italian presentation and all legacy debug route groups.
limitations: Runtime frontend build, native Windows and physical input were not checked; the broader English-first audit remains open.
